verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo and AGENTS.md docs thoroughly document an official `npx skills` CLI with a full command set (add, use, list, update, remove, init, find, experimental_install/sync) supporting 70+ agents, CI/CD flags, and repo/URL sources — clearly an AI-native, agentic CLI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party validation of the CLI's reliability (community discussion focuses mainly on leaderboard ranking transparency, not CLI functionality) and no evidence of a companion REST API for non-CLI automation.
